subject: Pilot stipend approval + SaaS access controls
messages:
From: Nora Liu <nora.liu@ignite-accelerator.org>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@ignite-accelerator.org
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot stipend request for Cohort 5 — Redwood in Ignite accelerator

Hi Michael,

Hope you’re well — excited to get Redwood into Ignite’s Cohort 5. We run a 12-week pilot for 10 startups and would like to request a partner-funded stipend to cover test/dev usage so teams can meaningfully evaluate latency/cost and go-to-prod patterns.

High level ask: $15,000 in Redwood trial credits distributed across 10 participants (3-month duration), with basic monitoring enabled and one sandbox private deployment for the lead startup.

We attached the program scope (pilot_scope.pdf) and a short vendor security worksheet. Two asks from our side:
- Confirmation of whether credits can be escrowed to Ignite and released by cohort activation.
- Any SSO/VPC onboarding lead times or IP allowlist requirements we should surface to founders.

Procurement copied here for PO/terms. We have a deadline for allocations on Jun 20 to hit orientation. Can you confirm next steps and an estimated timeline?

Thanks,
Nora Liu
Program Director
Ignite Accelerator

Attachments: pilot_scope.pdf
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Nora Liu <nora.liu@ignite-accelerator.org>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, procurement@ignite-accelerator.org
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot stipend request for Cohort 5 — Redwood in Ignite accelerator

Nora — thanks for the note and the scope doc. This is the kind of partner program we want to support. Quick answers up front:
- Escrowed allocation: feasible, we have a partner-stipend flow (ops + legal sign-off) but need a short agreement and an activation checklist.
- VPC/SSO: we can provide sandbox VPC access; typical lead time is 5–7 business days for a private deployment and IP allowlist.

Looping in Vanessa (partner ops) and Kimberly (security/compliance) to scope approvals and the security checklist. Vanessa — can you confirm whether we can pre-authorize a $15k cohort stipend and what internal approvals are needed? Kimberly — can you look at the vendor worksheet and call out any blockers for sandbox access (SOC2 evidence, network controls, data residency)?

Michael
VP, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Nora Liu <nora.liu@ignite-accelerator.org>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, procurement@ignite-accelerator.org
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot stipend request for Cohort 5 — Redwood in Ignite accelerator

Thanks, Michael. Nora — we can provision a cohort stipend via our partner-escrow process. Operational checklist: 

1) Partner stipend agreement (term sheet) — I can draft; legal review 2 business days.
2) Activation matrix — list of cohort startups + lead contact emails and which ones need private sandbox (you mentioned 1).
3) Security gating — Kimberly, please confirm the minimal artifacts we need to enable VPC sandbox and whether we require a signed DPA.
4) PO or DocuSign (procurement) — we accept a PO or DocuSign signature for the stipend release.

We typically hold credits in escrow under a partner code and release upon cohort activation. Can you share the startup list by Thu (18th) to meet your Jun 20 orientation date?

Attachments: security_questions.xlsx (placeholder — Kimberly will update)

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Devon Carter <devon@cloudlaunch.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Nora Liu <nora.liu@ignite-accelerator.org>
Cc: procurement@ignite-accelerator.org
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 12:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot stipend request for Cohort 5 — Redwood in Ignite accelerator

Appreciate the quick responses. Procurement — please find our PO template attached (po_template.pdf). We completed the security questionnaire inline and uploaded a signed DPA to the DocuSign link below for legal. A couple clarifications: 

- Can the sandbox VPC be limited to a single public region (us-west-2) for the lead startup? If so, we’ll provide IP ranges for the allowlist.
- Is it possible to allocate credits at the startup level so Ignite can track per-team consumption? That helps us control spend during the pilot.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-IGNITE-2025

On Mon, Jun 16, 2025 at 8:34 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Michael. Nora — we can provision a cohort stipend via our partner-escrow process...

Devon Carter
CloudLaunch (SI partner)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Nora Liu <nora.liu@ignite-accelerator.org>, Devon Carter <devon@cloudlaunch.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, procurement@ignite-accelerator.org
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2025 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot stipend request for Cohort 5 — Redwood in Ignite accelerator

Nora/Devon — all sounds good. Summary and next steps: 

- Redwood approves a $15,000 cohort stipend (DEAL-3247). Credits will be held under partner code IGNITE-2025 and can be allocated at the startup level once we have the activation list.
- Ops: Vanessa will create the partner stipend agreement and escrow record; expected internal approval by Wed (Jun 17).
- Security: Kimberly confirms we only need a signed DPA + completed security questionnaire to enable the single-region sandbox (us-west-2). Kimberly — if you see anything heavier than that please flag.
- Procurement: Devon/procurement team — please complete DocuSign by EOD Wed. Our finance team requires the DocuSign/PO to finalize allocation.

I'll follow up with a short activation checklist and a HubSpot link to the deal. Congrats — we’ll prioritize this so cohort orientation is not impacted.

Best,
Michael Grant
VP, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: pilot_scope.pdf, security_questions.xlsx, po_template.pdf
